messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: Pager — billing-metering DELAY detected in APAC ingestion (consumer lag > 30m) — severity: P2 — paging oncall
oncall-alex: seeing pager, investigating. hopping in.
maria-ops: confirmed spike in kafka consumer lag on topic 'usage.events.apac'. offsets stalled after last deploy ~22:13 UTC.
billing-sre: customers showing delayed usage in reporting; a subset got transient overage flags in console but no charge processed yet. note: billing pipeline marks flags before final commit.
oncall-alex: @billing-sre can you confirm charge gate? If flags only, we can avoid customer billing impact with backfill reconciliation.
billing-sre: charge gate is intact — charges are batched and require final tally job (cron) which hasn't run. risk is UI/alert noise only, but we should avoid false notifications.
eng-ryan: root cause: consumer instances at 3/5 crashed due to new consumer group change in deploy. They restarted but lag didn't catch because max.poll.records small; also noticed occasional MessageFormatException in logs.
maria-ops: logs snippet:
```
[2024-06-15T22:14:02Z] kafka.consumer ERROR ConsumerFetch: MessageFormatException at partition 3
[2024-06-15T22:14:03Z] consumer info Restarting consumer instance id=5 cause=OutOfMemoryError
```
oncall-alex: mitigation step 1: scale up consumer replicas + bump max.poll.records to 500 to catch up. applying now.
support-jordan: paging support: any customers already pinging? I have two open chats: ACME-co and FallbackInc — both saw overage badges but not billed. Pushing note to them.
billing-sre: starting backfill/replay plan: replay offsets from t-40m into tally stream, run in dry-run mode first to validate counts. Will tag metrics with `replay_candidate:true`.
eng-ryan: started scale + config change. Monitoring dashboards show lag dropping from 35m -> 4m in last 6m. CPU on consumers at 75%.
oncall-alex: follow-on: schedule a throttled replay at +10m once lag <5m. we don't want duplicates. Use idempotent replayer v2.
billing-sre: ran dry-run, deltas look good: +0.003% variance. no new charges. proceeding with controlled replay now.
incidentbot: :white_check_mark: Update — lag reduced, replay completed, false overage flags cleared from UI. Incident status: mitigated — handing to oncall for monitoring for 2h.
oncall-alex: will monitor. filing incident ticket and postmortem to explain deploy consumer-group change + add smoke test to preflight. tagging @cto-lina for follow-up on release gating.
cto-lina: thanks — please include timeline and customer outreach note. good catch everyone.
support-jordan: notified customers with explanation and 'no-bill' confirmation. closing chats.
oncall-alex: last check: dashboards stable, no further lag. closing thread in 2h unless regress. thx all :thumbsup:
